answer.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ. Two direct precedents show simplification works: memory_86 (day 52) demonstrated shortening onboarding lifted early adoption, and memory_31 (day 12) showed signup field reduction produced durable first-week activation lift. Both interventions are low-risk, address the immediate metrics decline, and align with self-serve segments unaffected by competitive pricing pressure. Enterprise sales assist targets a different segment; referral incentives work on established bases; promotional pricing directly conflicts with the stated objective of sustainable qualified revenue (risks margin and attracts price-sensitive churn).
